description: Dataset for building energy consumption prediction based on neural network Dataset for building energy consumption prediction based on neural network is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Chen Song, Ren Tingting (Hefei Institutes of Physical Science). The dataset file contains the energy consumption data of three buildings which are indicated in three tables respectively. Each table contains 7 columns. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 10519 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
